title: Christmas Expansion
description: Christmas decorations and tools, ex: snowy bricks, string lights,
body:
**Christmas Expansion**
This mod adds lots of Christmas decorations and tools!

Mailbox: if you right-click it with a letter for Santa after a while you get either coal, diamonds, or on of the blocks or items in this mod.

Jingle Bells: When you jump with the item you can jump 5 block high

Candy Cane: A deadly weapon

This mod adds Snowy Bricks, String Lights, Letter to Santa, Mailbox, Jingle Bells, Candy Cane, and a Festive Pig

[My YT](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHBxliTPkVU_wT-_bfHv-pQ)
